title: Personal Credit Cards: when a late fee or a returned payment fee is billed, and how much
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: late fee and returned payment fee rules

This policy covers the late fee and the returned payment fee on the Personal Credit Cards line: when each is billed, which late fee amount applies, the caps on both fees, and what happens when both could arise from one missed payment. The fee amounts and the look-back length are the tier's own terms.

## Policy clauses

1. A late fee is billed when the payments and credits posted from the statement closing date through the payment due date total less than that statement's minimum payment due.
2. The late fee is the tier's repeat late fee when an unreversed late fee is found in the preceding look-back cycles, and the tier's first late fee otherwise, but never more than the minimum payment due that was missed.
3. The late fee is billed as a late payment fee for the statement cycle whose due date was missed.
4. A statement with no minimum payment due never incurs a late fee.
5. At most one late fee is billed per statement.
6. A payment returned unpaid reverses its credit and incurs the tier's returned payment fee, linked to the returned payment, never more than the minimum payment due on the statement it was meant to pay.
7. Only one of the late fee and the returned payment fee may be billed for the same missed minimum payment: when the return makes the payment late, only the late fee is billed.

## How the look-back search works

The search covers the statement cycles immediately preceding the cycle being billed, as many as the tier's look-back length. It counts late fees in those cycles that have no reversal. A late fee that was later reversed is not an unreversed late fee.

## Decision table

| Situation | Fee billed |
|---|---|
| payments and credits by the due date below the minimum due; no unreversed late fee in the look-back | first late fee, capped at the missed minimum |
| payments and credits by the due date below the minimum due; an unreversed late fee in the look-back | repeat late fee, capped at the missed minimum |
| payments and credits by the due date at least the minimum due | no late fee |
| statement with no minimum payment due | no late fee |
| payment returned unpaid, and the return does not make the payment late | returned payment fee, capped at that statement's minimum due |
| payment returned unpaid, and the return makes the payment late | the late fee only |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

- Minimum due 50.00 USD; payments and credits in the window total 49.99 USD: a late fee is billed. They total 50.00 USD: no late fee, because the total is not less than the minimum.
- Minimum due 20.00 USD on a tier whose first late fee is taken as 30.00 USD for the example: the late fee billed is 20.00 USD, the missed minimum.
- The only late fee in the look-back was reversed: the first late fee applies, not the repeat late fee.
